newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel says EMI plan will help secure price stability.
newsitem.headline: Waigel says EMI plan will help secure price stability.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Friday the European Monetary Institute's (EMI) plan for the future European Central Bank would help secure price stability.
The plan for a unified European monetary policy would also help European Union members implement the stability pact for currency union, Waigel said.
Earlier on Friday, the EMI unveiled proposals for monetary policy instruments for the future European Central Bank.
The plan "will put the European Central Bank in a position to fulfil its monetary policy mission of securing price stability," Waigel said in a statement.
"The EMI concept supports...the efforts of Germany and the governments of other member states (to achieve) a convincing implementation of the stability pact.
"Price stability and solid finances are the indispensable pillars of a successful currency union," he said.
The EMI plan sets a framework for financial markets that meets the principles of efficiency and neutrality, even if the details remain to be filled in, he said.
